guide.inmersivebackpack.title: Inmersive Backpack - How to play
guide.inmersivebackpack.open: Opens the backpack you carry. The key works with the backpack anywhere in your inventory; right click needs it in your hand.
guide.inmersivebackpack.quickmove: Moves it between your inventory and the backpack. A backpack can never go inside another one.
guide.inmersivebackpack.lantern: Only lanterns fit. It hangs from your backpack on a short rope and lights up around you like it would in your hand.
guide.inmersivebackpack.keys.bedroll: Bed or carpet in the red slot
guide.inmersivebackpack.bedroll: It becomes your bedroll. Without one you cannot sleep on the ground.
guide.inmersivebackpack.keys.sleep: Shift + right click on the ground
guide.inmersivebackpack.sleep: With the backpack in hand, aim at the top of a solid block at night or in a storm. The bedroll unrolls and the camera switches to third person.
guide.inmersivebackpack.wake: You get up at dawn, or with the 'Leave Bed' button. The bedroll rolls back up on its own.
guide.inmersivebackpack.craft: Leather: 6 leather, chest, string, iron ingot. Rabbit hide: 4 rabbit hide, 2 leather, chest, string, iron ingot. Search 'backpack' in the recipe book.
guide.inmersivebackpack.guide: Opens this guide at any time.
